## Open educational resources

Teaching material here is openly licensed so it can be reused with attribution:

- **Slides, notes, exercises** — [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
- **Code, scripts, infrastructure** — [MIT](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)

## Reusable infrastructure

- [**teaching-template**](https://github.com/hoelzer-science/teaching-template)
  — the course skeleton behind these modules, for anyone building their own.
  See [Infrastructure](infrastructure.qmd) for how it works.

## Prerequisite material

- [**Linux Crash Course**](https://linux.hoelzer.science) — the command line,
  package management and Git: the working baseline every practical assumes.
  Public and free-standing rather than tied to one module, so it is equally
  useful before you enrol anywhere.

## Course material

Openly shareable figures, datasets and decks will be collected here as the
courses develop. Course-specific material stays on the individual course sites,
available to enrolled students.
